example_sentences_in_bangla: তার স্বাস্থ্য দিনে দিনে উন্নত হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Her health is improving day by day.
Prices are rising day by day.
history: Literary reference in Rabindranath Tagore's works, such as in the line describing increasing debt and lack of trade.
note: Common in Bengali literature and everyday speech to denote incremental change.
